## Jye's Jan-Mar 2026 Data

::: panel-tabset

### Data processing

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Read combined trial-level data
fle_data_26 <- read.csv(
  "/Users/imanelattab/Desktop/Honours/Data/Directional-Asymmetries-in-MPIs/EXPERIMENT 2 (JAN - MAR 2026)/E2 DATA/ALL_participants_combined.csv"
)

fle_data_26_long <- read.csv(
  "/Users/imanelattab/Desktop/Honours/Data/Directional-Asymmetries-in-MPIs/EXPERIMENT 2 (JAN - MAR 2026)/E2 DATA/E2_combined_long_format.csv"
)

# Initial trial-level cleaning
fle_trials <- fle_data_26 |>
  filter(
    valid == "valid",
    !is.na(participant),
    !is.na(foveal_offset)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    participant = factor(participant),

    motion_direction = factor(
      motion_direction,
      levels = c("fugal", "petal")
    ),

    condition = factor(
      condition,
      levels = c(
        "flashbaseline",
        "centralcue",
        "motionbaseline",
        "flash_motion",
        "motion_flash"
      )
    ),

    horizontal_field = case_when(
      quadrant %in% c("upper_left", "lower_left") ~ "left",
      quadrant %in% c("upper_right", "lower_right") ~ "right",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    vertical_field = case_when(
      quadrant %in% c("upper_left", "upper_right") ~ "upper",
      quadrant %in% c("lower_left", "lower_right") ~ "lower",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    participant,
    block,
    trial
  )

# Check valid trial numbers for each participant and direction
fle_trials |>
  count(
    participant,
    motion_direction,
    name = "n_valid_trials"
  )
```


:::

### Raw FLE

```{r}
fle_raw_trials <- fle_trials |>
  filter(
    motion_direction %in% c("fugal", "petal"),
    condition %in% c("motion_flash", "flash_motion")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    condition = droplevels(condition),

    # Direction-corrected condition contrast
    #
    # Petal FLE:
    # flash_motion - motion_flash
    #
    # Fugal FLE:
    # motion_flash - flash_motion
    condition_contrast = case_when(
      motion_direction == "petal" &
        condition == "flash_motion" ~ 0.5,

      motion_direction == "petal" &
        condition == "motion_flash" ~ -0.5,

      motion_direction == "fugal" &
        condition == "motion_flash" ~ 0.5,

      motion_direction == "fugal" &
        condition == "flash_motion" ~ -0.5,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(condition_contrast)) |>
  arrange(
    participant,
    motion_direction,
    block,
    trial
  )

# Check trial numbers in each condition
fle_raw_trials |>
  count(
    participant,
    motion_direction,
    condition,
    name = "n_trials"
  )
```


:::


:::

## Calculate FLE


::: panel-tabset

### participant FLE means

```{r}
fle_condition_means <- fle_raw_trials |>
  group_by(
    participant,
    motion_direction,
    condition
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_foveal_offset = mean(
      foveal_offset,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sd_foveal_offset = sd(
      foveal_offset,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_trials = sum(
      !is.na(foveal_offset)
    ),

    se_foveal_offset =
      sd_foveal_offset / sqrt(n_trials),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

fle_condition_means
```


:::

### Columns for motion direction

```{r}
fle_participant_means <- fle_condition_means |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(
      participant,
      motion_direction
    ),

    names_from = condition,

    values_from = c(
      mean_foveal_offset,
      sd_foveal_offset,
      se_foveal_offset,
      n_trials
    ),

    names_sep = "_"
  )
```


:::

### Direction corrected FLE

```{r}
fle_participant_FLE <- fle_participant_means |>
  mutate(
    FLE_dva = case_when(
      motion_direction == "petal" ~
        mean_foveal_offset_flash_motion -
        mean_foveal_offset_motion_flash,

      motion_direction == "fugal" ~
        mean_foveal_offset_motion_flash -
        mean_foveal_offset_flash_motion,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # Standard error of the difference between condition means
    FLE_se = sqrt(
      se_foveal_offset_flash_motion^2 +
      se_foveal_offset_motion_flash^2
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(FLE_dva)
  ) |>
  arrange(
    participant,
    motion_direction
  )

fle_participant_FLE
```


:::

### Save dataset

```{r}
participant_output_path <- paste0(
  "/Users/imanelattab/Downloads/",
  "FLE_petal_fugal_participant_means.csv"
)

write_csv(
  fle_participant_FLE,
  participant_output_path
)

message(
  "Combined participant-level FLE dataset saved to: ",
  participant_output_path
)
```
